objective: A frozen exploratory census, exact: from balanced seeds (loops of 3 to 6 rings, two rings sharing 3 to 5 contacts, the five Platonic networks, the 3 x 3 and 4 x 4 square tori, the genus-2 network of 16 rings), every way to attach one new ring by 1 to 3 contacts (and 4 on seeds of at most 8 rings), and the truncations and rectifications of the Platonic networks: whether every contact keeps even return counts.
status: Closed: supported 2026-11-08 (exploratory, exact; H1 and H2 hold): of 795,042 attachments of one new ring to 16 balanced seeds, none by 1 or 2 contacts keeps every contact persistent and none by 3 or 4 does on any seed of more than four rings (only from the loop of 3 rings, two rings sharing 3 contacts and the tetrahedron); truncating or rectifying the Platonic networks loses persistence except the rectified tetrahedron.
title: A census of growth steps
